collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — GOOD, BAD AND ORDINARY DAYS (DAY-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Wonderful days, rotten days, mixed days and days when nothing much happens at all. Moods come without reasons, small things matter more than they should, and nobody has to end the day happier, wiser or more productive than they started it.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: A villager wakes wanting to do nice things and leaves fruit for a friend, who is suspicious: own up, or say nothing.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) woke up today wanting to do something nice for someone. Anyone. (subject.He/she) doesn't know why. So far (subject.he/she) has fetched water for (neighbor), swept someone else's doorstep and left a piece of fruit on (friend)'s windowsill. (friend) has just found the fruit and is looking around suspiciously.

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: "It was me," says (subject). "No reason." (friend) is touched and a little puzzled. "Are you sure nothing's wrong?" "Nothing's wrong." (friend) eats the fruit. Later, (friend.he/she) leaves a piece of fruit on someone else's windowsill. By evening, fruit is turning up on windowsills all over the village.

o2__fx.name: Outcome B
o2__fx.text: (subject) stays out of sight. (friend) eats the fruit, looking very puzzled. All day, small nice things happen around the village and nobody knows where they came from. A few people start to suspect each other. (subject) never says a word. It's (subject.his/her) favorite secret all week.
